info.name: NEC Middleware API
info.description:
Full API collection for NEC Middleware — Auth, Roles, Users, Permission Groups, Role-Permissions, Modules, Groups, and Permissions.

Base URL is stored in {{baseUrl}} (default: http://localhost:8082/nec). HTTP status codes indicate success/failure. Success: { success, message, data }. Error: { success, errorCode, message }. isActive: 1=active, 0=inactive. isDeleted: 0=not deleted, 1=deleted.

After login, the test script auto-saves accessToken and refreshToken to collection variables.

Auth endpoints include:
- Login (POST /api/v1/auth/login)
- Refresh token (POST /api/v1/auth/refresh)
- Logout (POST /api/v1/auth/logout)
- Forgot password (POST /api/v1/auth/forgot-password)
- Reset password (POST /api/v1/auth/reset-password)
- Update password (PUT /api/v1/auth/update-password)
- Get user context (POST /api/v1/auth/user-context) - Returns current user's profile, role, and permissions

--- ROLE CODE AUTO-GENERATION ---
Do NOT include roleCode in Create Role requests. The service generates it automatically:
  Format : <PREFIX><3-digit-sequence>  e.g. ADMIN001
  Prefix : derived from the first word of roleName (vowel-boundary algorithm)
  Examples:
    Administrator  →  ADMIN001, ADMIN002 …
    Finance        →  FIN001,   FIN002   …
    HR Officer     →  HR001
    Procurement    →  PROC001
    Logistics      →  LOG001
    Communication  →  COMM001
    Director       →  DIR001
    Deputy         →  DEP001
